name: University of Edinburgh
typicalOffer: AAB, Biology and Chemistry, one at A and one at B; Mathematics or Physics recommended
notes: Scottish 4-year BSc (Hons); one of the UK's leading pharmacology departments; Chemistry and Biology required; strong links to pharma industry in Edinburgh

name: University College London
typicalOffer: AAB, Chemistry plus one of Biology, Life and Health Sciences, Mathematics or Physics
notes: 3-year BSc with research project component; Chemistry and Biology required; close links to UCL School of Pharmacy and clinical research at UCLH

name: University of Manchester
typicalOffer: AAA-AAB, including two of Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics (the Core Sciences)
notes: 3-year BSc and 4-year MPharmacol; Chemistry and Biology required; pioneering G-protein coupled receptor research centre on campus

name: King's College London
typicalOffer: AAA, including grade A in Biology and Chemistry
notes: 3-year BSc based in the Faculty of Life Sciences; Chemistry and Biology required; excellent proximity to major London NHS teaching hospitals

name: University of Bristol
typicalOffer: AAB, including Chemistry and one of Biology (or Human Biology), Physics, Mathematics (or Further Mathematics)
notes: 3-year BSc covering drug targets, toxicology and clinical pharmacology; Chemistry or Biology required; close collaboration with Bristol's medical school

name: University of Nottingham
typicalOffer: AAB-ABB, including chemistry and one of biology/human biology, physics, physical education, mathematics, statistics, life and health sciences
notes: 3-year BSc with strong pharmaceutical sciences links; Chemistry required; access to Centre for Biomolecular Sciences and Boots Drug Discovery Unit

name: University of Leeds
typicalOffer: AAB, including Biology or Chemistry, plus another science or science-related subject
notes: 3-year BSc including integrated pharmacokinetics and drug design modules; Chemistry or Biology required; strong links to Leeds Teaching Hospitals

name: University of Glasgow
typicalOffer: AAB, A-level Biology or Chemistry at grade A
notes: Scottish 4-year BSc (Hons); Chemistry and Biology required; strong cardiovascular and CNS drug research; BPS-accredited department

name: University of Bath
typicalOffer: AAB, including Chemistry and one other science or mathematics subject
notes: 3-year BSc with optional industrial placement year; Chemistry and Biology required; excellent industry links with GlaxoSmithKline, AstraZeneca and Pfizer for placements

name: University of Leicester
typicalOffer: BBB, including at least two relevant science subjects from Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Physics or Psychology; General Studies not accepted
notes: No course under the listed title; this is the university’s closest course in the subject.

name: University of Reading
notes: 3-year BSc with strong drug design and neuropharmacology modules; Biology or Chemistry required; links to pharmaceutical companies in the Thames Valley corridor

name: Keele University
typicalOffer: ABB, including B in two Science subjects from the Keele Defined Sciences List
notes: 3-year BSc; Biology or Chemistry required; unique dual honours option with Biology, Chemistry or Neuroscience; BPS-affiliated department
